article.title: Friday Complete Market Report: Nifty 22,600, Sensex 73,123.83 | 23 October 2026
article.dek: The Nifty 50 lost 2.36% this week while mid and small caps fell much harder. NSE sector heatmap, breadth and institutional flows inside.

visualSpec.weekLabel: Change from the close on Fri 16 Oct to Fri 23 Oct (NSE)
visualSpec.fiiDiiNote: NSE provisional figures for the cash market on Friday, in ₹ crore.

reportTakeaways: The Nifty 50 ended the week 2.36% lower; the Midcap 100 lost 5.63% and the Smallcap 100 7.27%.
Only IT, among the NSE sector indices shown, gained over the week (+0.22%).
Foreign portfolio investors and domestic institutions were both net buyers in Friday's cash market.
reportWatch: India VIX, which rose 6.32% on Friday
body: What moved | The Nifty 50 closed the week at 22,600.00, down 2.36% from the previous Friday's 23,146.15, and fell 0.39% on Friday itself. The damage was far worse below the top 50 stocks: the Nifty Next 50 lost 4.58% over the week, the Midcap 100 5.63% and the Smallcap 100 7.27%.
Breadth | On Friday 450 stocks in the Nifty 500 fell and 50 rose, according to NSE. India VIX, which measures the volatility traders expect, rose 6.32% to 16.76.
Sectors | Every sector index in the heatmap fell on Friday. Over the week consumer durables (−6.42%), metal (−5.40%), media (−5.15%) and realty (−5.04%) fell most; IT edged up 0.22%.
Flows | NSE's provisional data show foreign portfolio investors bought a net ₹887.65 crore of shares on Friday and domestic institutions a net ₹3,235.36 crore, even as prices fell.
Why it mattered | Reuters linked the week's losses to surging oil prices amid Middle East tensions, which raise concerns about inflation, company margins and the rupee.
article.indiaImpact: Losses were concentrated in mid and small caps, so many portfolios fell more than the Nifty 50 suggests. Check breadth and sector moves, not just the headline indices.
